changelog.title: DD214/NGB-22 name extraction survives OCR reading-order scrambling
changelog.description: Box 1 name isolation no longer requires "2. DEPARTMENT" to appear after "1. NAME" in the OCR text stream; real scans routinely read in column order, not printed order

changelog.title: recover NGB-22 Box 18 label OCR misses and fix Box 7a place-of-entry numbering
changelog.description: label normalization (e.g. "1A DT" -> "IADT") recovers activation-window date ranges that were previously dropped entirely

changelog.title: extracted name now reaches the Profile and Service tabs
changelog.description: whitelist and profile-mapping gaps were silently dropping a correctly-extracted DD214/NGB-22 name; the Service tab now also cites the real source form instead of a hardcoded "DD-214, Block 1"

changelog.title: multi-period service history model gains NGB-22 activation windows
changelog.description: Box 18 IADT/AD date ranges now feed servicePeriods[] as additional periods alongside the primary DD214 period

changelog.title: C-File ingestion actually extracts, stores, and surfaces findings for large consolidated files
changelog.description: documentClassifier was scoring only the first 10,000 characters of a file, misclassifying 2,000+ page consolidated C-Files and leaving the entire medical-segmentation path dead

changelog.title: Ribbon Rack: 780 state/territory National Guard awards across all 54 jurisdictions
changelog.description: award and ribbon matching now covers 50 states + DC/PR/GU/VI on top of the existing 89 federal awards

changelog.title: dedupe re-imported documents in My Packet
changelog.description: re-importing the same DD214/document no longer appends a duplicate row; existing entries are updated in place

changelog.title: Tools menu: add Appeals Lane Advisor, Remand Risk Checker, and Knowledge Base

changelog.title: correct Diamond Knowledge Base docs to match live shard/state data
